title: penv local settings
description: Personal developer settings for project-env-utils (gitignored, not shared).

secret_backend.description: Which secret backend to use. Defaults to 'sqlite' when not set.

onepassword_vault.description: Override the 1Password vault name from settings.json. Only relevant when secret_backend is 'onepassword'.

session_multiplexer.description: Terminal multiplexer to use for dev sessions.
